note: Adapted from the species description in Chhotani (1997), originally in English; the alate is recorded as unknown, only the soldier and worker being described, and the soldier is described from the holotype; synonymy lists, literature citations, figure numbers and distribution records are omitted.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule bright yellow, antennae pale yellow, mandibles dark reddish brown, body and legs nearly white. Head capsule rather densely pilose, body densely pilose. Body length 3.7–4.10 mm. Head capsule subrectangular, anterolateral angles distinctly projecting forward; frontal projection prominent, acute, conical, extending far beyond the mandible base and covering almost the whole labrum (length to mandible base 1.10–1.15 mm, to apex of frontal projection 1.34–1.44 mm, maximum width 0.85–0.88 mm). Frontal gland large. Antennae 14-segmented, segment 3 slightly longer than segment 2, segment 4 shortest. Anterior margin of labrum deeply incurved (length 0.23–0.27 mm, width 0.21–0.23 mm). Mandibles longer than head, slender and rod-like (length 1.24–1.38 mm, left mandible length/head length 1.10–1.21). Postmentum short, rod-like, waist weakly constricted (length 0.36–0.40 mm, maximum width 0.28–0.34 mm, minimum width 0.20–0.24 mm, constriction index 0.70–0.85). Pronotum strongly saddle-shaped, anterior margin not notched (length 0.11–0.15 mm, maximum width 0.38–0.44 mm).

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Head capsule straw yellow, thorax and legs nearly white; head and body rather densely pilose. Body length 3.90–4.10 mm. Head capsule subcircular (length to apex of labrum 0.90–0.98 mm, length to mandible base 0.70 mm, maximum width 0.80 mm). Antennae 14-segmented, segment 3 about as long as segment 4. Postclypeus inflated, pilose, about half as long as wide (length 0.18–0.24 mm, width 0.36–0.42 mm). Pronotum strongly saddle-shaped (length 0.18–0.24 mm, width 0.40–0.45 mm).
